import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        TreeMap<Integer, Integer> cnt = new TreeMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            cnt.put(x, cnt.getOrDefault(x, 0) + 1);
        }
        int w = sc.nextInt();
        int ans = 0;
        for (int start = 1; start <= 1000; start++) {
            int cur = 0;
            NavigableMap<Integer, Integer> sub = cnt.subMap(start, true, start + w, true);
            for (int val : sub.values()) {
                cur += val;
            }
            if (cur > ans) ans = cur;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
